# Load data

```{r}
library(decontam); packageVersion("decontam") #using version 1.29.0
library(ggplot2); packageVersion("ggplot2")
library("readr")
library(phyloseq); packageVersion("phyloseq") # using ‘1.53.0’

```

```{r}
setwd("~/Documents/WHOI/Projects/LittleCaymanTransplant_Analyses")
```

```{r}
load("otus_LCT_AllSamples_final.RData")
ASV <- as.matrix(otus)

taxa <- as.matrix(read.table("taxonomy_LCT_AllSamples_final.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, header = TRUE))

ASV_ID <-read.table("ASVsequences_LCT_AllSamples_final.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = 1, header = TRUE)

metadata <- read.csv("Meta_Data.csv", header = TRUE)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_names
```

```{r}
#How many negative controls are there?
sum(metadata$Sample_Type == "Control") 
#33
```

#Phyloseq object

```{r}
ASV = otu_table(ASV, taxa_are_rows = FALSE)
TAX = tax_table(taxa)
META = sample_data(metadata)

ps <- phyloseq(ASV, TAX, META)
```

#Inspect library size

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps)) # Put sample_data into a ggplot-friendly data.frame
df$LibrarySize <- sample_sums(ps)
df <- df[order(df$LibrarySize),]
df$Index <- seq(nrow(df))
ggplot(data=df, aes(x=Index, y=LibrarySize, color=Sample_Type)) + geom_point()
```
The negative control samples have fewer reads as expected.






#Run decontam
```{r}
#identify the negative controls as TRUE in is.neg
sample_data(ps)$is.neg <- sample_data(ps)$Sample_Type == "Control"

#change non-detected from 0 to 0.001 because decontam requires a number that is not zero
sample_data(ps)$PCR_Concentration[sample_data(ps)$PCR_Concentration == 0] <- 0.001

#run decontam with default threshold (0.1)
contam <- isContaminant(ps, 
                        method="combined", 
                        neg="is.neg", 
                        conc="PCR_Concentration")
save(contam, file="contam.RData")
```

#Inspect contaminants:

```{r}
table(contam$contaminant)

contam_list <- which(contam$contaminant)
contam_list <- paste0("ASV", contam_list)

contam_taxa <- taxa[rownames(taxa) %in% contam_list, ]

write.csv(contam_taxa, file = "contaminant_taxa.csv")

```

#Histogram 
```{r}
histo <- ggplot(data=contam, aes(x=p)) + 
  labs(x = 'decontam-prevalence Score', y='Number of ASVs') + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.02)
histo


### Add a column with binned prevalances
contam$Prevalence_Binned <- cut(contam$prev, c(0, 10, 25, 45, 19999), labels=c("1-10", "11-25", "26-45", "45+"))
histo <- ggplot(data=contam, aes(x=p)) + 
  labs(x = 'decontam-prevalence Score', y='Number of ASVs') + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.02)
histo + facet_wrap(~Prevalence_Binned)


```
